items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: I remember the time when Dizzy used to sound a lot like Roy Eldridge. ... Roy Eldridge was playing trumpet, and that's the one where Ben Webster called up Norman Granz.

ctx.x: And Dizzy certainly acknowledges the doors that preceded him.
Yes. Back with Louis, Roy, Roy Eldridge, he -- I remember the time when Dizzy used to sound a lot like Roy Eldridge.
Well, he admits this. He said that Roy was his inspiration.
